title: Children born in lockdown show weaker executive function at age 4, study finds
desc: Children born during the first COVID-19 lockdown in England had lower reported levels of executive function—crucial skills involved in making plans, solving problems and adapting to new situations—suggest findings from a study published online in the Archives of Disease in Childhood.
